merged_issues.title: Missing or empty document title
merged_issues.description: The page does not have a non-empty <title> element. A descriptive title helps screen reader users understand the page context and improves navigation (and is also important for search results).
merged_issues.recommended_fix: Add a meaningful, non-empty <title> in the document <head>, e.g. <title>Page name – Site name</title>, and ensure it updates appropriately for each page/view.

merged_issues.title: Missing main landmark
merged_issues.description: The document does not include a main landmark, which helps assistive technology users quickly navigate to the primary content of the page.
merged_issues.recommended_fix: Wrap the primary page content in a single <main> element (or an element with role="main"), and ensure there is only one main landmark per page.
